notes.title: Yes, It’s Finally Happening – The Update!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

We are getting closer and closer to being able to share more details about the incoming first big update. First of all, instead of one giga giga gigantic update, we decided to break it up into two [i](maaaybee, possibly even three)[/i] updates. 

Originally, the big idea behind 0.2 was not just to squash bugs and fix stuff, but to roll out a bunch of many new content at the same time. [i]Ambitious? Totally. Doable? Absolutely. But... time-consuming? Oh yeah.[/i] That way, we don’t keep you waiting forever, and you get to play with the new stuff sooner. We'll also be dropping smaller patches in between to keep things fresh. [b]Don't get this wrong, it’s still a pretty big deal for us![/b] And we probably call this major update as 0.1
 
[h1]Now, what’s in 0.1?[/h1]
 
Well, firstly the programming... ohh, the coding is fully changing, we’ve moved huge part of it from Blueprints to C++, which means better performance and more flexibility down the line. Animations, Gunplay [i](Some new guns?)[/i] better ballistics behaviours, tweaks on UI, maybe even a few mission objective adjustments. The current content in the live version will still be there, but you’ll notice changes in the maps [i](lighting, atmosphere, some layout revamps)[/i] Oh, and there might [i](well its a big MIGHT but)[/i] be a little new mission map sneaking in.

We’ve also working on for improving the AI. AI may be not going to be perfect right now but better, no more behind the walls cheeky sneaky behaviours.

We’re listening to you constantly — what you like, what you want changed, what’s not working. Your feedback is what’s steering this ship. So don’t stop talking to us. Once 0.1 is out and stable, we’ll follow up with 0.2 that includes new shiny things. After that? We keep building, improving, polishing — and eventually, we’ll hit the next update. But we’ll keep the details for that one under wraps for now. Gotta keep some surprises, right?

We needed [i](still some need)[/i] time to ensure that we can meet the some basic standards you all have been waiting all along. And we've set ourselves to meet the expectations. Thanks for sticking with us. This journey's been wild, and will continue to be.

As many of you know, much of our Dev Team has changed over the past year.
The fresh team has brought new energy and perspective, and we’re excited about the progress they’ve made! [b]They are online in the Contain Discord server and are happy to answer your questions![/b]

[h3]We’re also preparing a public test for those eager to try the update early, share valuable feedback, and help us ensure everything’s in top shape before this Update gets released.[/h3]

notes.title: Important Update on Contain's Price
notes.content:
We need to talk about something important: The price of our game. After weeks of discussions, we've decided to lower the base cost. We're committed to being transparent and want to assure you that we have plans to compensate everyone who paid the current price.

[h3]WHY THE CHANGE?[/h3]
Since our launch, we've realized the current price tag hasn't worked out. [u]Many of you cited the high price for an Early Access game and the lower prices of similar games as reasons for refunds.[/u] So, starting the 3rd of June, we’re reducing the price with a special discount, and this will be the permanent base price after the discount ends.

[h3]OUR COMMITMENT[/h3]
We still aim to develop a game worthy of the current price (as subjective as that may be). However, to fulfill our vision we need to make this price adjustment. We are committed to deliver the Contain experience we promised.

[h3]A SPECIAL THANK YOU[/h3]
We understand that those who paid the initial price may feel disappointed. To show our gratitude, we're handing out an [b]Exclusive Free DLC called "First Responders"[/b]. [u]This exclusive DLC will be automatically added to the accounts of the players who purchased the game until the 3rd of June.[/u]  It's our way of saying thank you, and [b]we will continue to expand this pack from time to time with even more goodies.[/b]

[h3]THE PATH FORWARD[/h3]
This way, we can keep improving Contain, and you get some exclusive goodies for your support. Thank you for understanding and staying with us on this journey.

notes.title: Let the communication flow!
notes.content:
It's been a while since we have updated the game but it's for a good reason. If you didn't catch the latest dev blog we have released, please consider checking it up from [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2186700/view/4195741362093196234][b]here[/b][/url] to learn what we are cooking.

Before we mention the current bugs and the next patch details. We would like to talk about the [b]two new features that we are working on with the Discord Community[/b]. If you are not joined yet, to get in touch please consider joining our[url=https://discord.gg/JQWh6C4DJA] Discord[/url]. We are online, and we mostly use Discord for instant, direct communications.

[h2]Progression System is shaping out![/h2]

As may you know we are working on a progression system. We are trying to figure out how to make it simple, effective, and good enough to spend time on for worthy progress with it.

A progression system has to show how much time you invested in the game. Like, do your character appearance, or even abilities, etc, reflect your time investment or not? We think it has to so we are working on this matter. Also as we can see, seems like most of the players don't like the idea of all currently available pieces of equipment, weapons, and attachments getting into a progression system, and from time to time with a reset losing it all again and again. But, Not just for Contain, but mainly with many other games that have that progressions and resets until it reaches its peak point. This is not a small issue we are concerned about.

As you all know we have a considerable arsenal, but still a small arsenal. Even though we are working on it to expand. This means, that unlocking current equipment, weapons, and attachments with a progression system will be a very short journey. Which is, that brings us to another issue, every time we try to balance leveling (experience, etc.) for the progression system or try to set the balance of weapons, etc, etc, we have to reset it from time to time. And this is unavoidable, we will have to eventually.

Long story short, for now, we decided not to add the current equipment, weapons, and attachments to the progression system when we introduce it. But this could change, with your feedback, even change at the final reset. So, no promises for that unseen feature for now! Because even a progression system can evolve many other shapes with feedback from you!

[h2]The other new game mechanic![/h2]

Let's talk about the other new game mechanic that we are planning and working on next to the player progression system.

This one is about adding smaller anomalies into the game that players have to capture/collect [i](needs to be extracted)[/i]. Then, you have to use a synthesizing machine in the Base of Operations to turn them into temporary boosters [i](we call them candies for now[/i]). Players will be able to choose one booster at a time before a mission deployment. The booster will persist until players return to the BoO.

[b]We created a pool in our discord for this one and it's getting upvotes![/b] To give a vote, tell us what you think about that new feature and tell us what boosters would you like to see, join the [url=https://discord.gg/JQWh6C4DJA]discord[/url]

[h2]A new map, and it's getting huge![/h2]

You may remember that we have announced that map before and shared some screenshots of it. But it's getting bigger and more complex. This new map is not like the others before, after this one we are considering adding more maps like this one instead of linear ones. On this one, we are planning to add a specific main mission like the old ones, but this one will have more randomized starting (player spawn) locations and a few objectives. Then you have to go to a random extraction location to finish the mission. [b]We keep sharing more detailed screenshots later![/b]

notes.title: Dev Blog 2
notes.content:
[h2]About the current known issues, fixes, and what we are up to?[/h2] 
We continue to receive feedback about different problems in different systems. So to simply put the biggest reason for these problems is that the current infrastructure is not programmed as it should be, and it's hard to detect and fix it immediately, so some of them take time to fix.
 
[h2]What we are going to do about it?[/h2] 
Thanks to our new programming team, we were able to detect this situation and had already started preparations and work for the necessary changes at a certain pace a while ago as we told you before. 

However, we could not fully accelerate the code base change because we had to continue patching the game. And trying to patch the game while using the current infrastructure made those fixes go slow.
 
But! [b]We would like to happily inform you[/b] that as of today, we have started to completely overhaul the code base infrastructure and get rid of the old one.
 
It will not take ages for you to meet these innovations and changes, they seem to be completed in a reasonable time frame. [b]However, we refrain from giving an exact date[/b]. And we think you will understand this. Giving a date but [b]presenting it before reaches a sufficient level, will mean repeating the mistake that we made at the release date[/b] and will make everyone unhappy once again.
 
However, [b]while making this change, we keep working on some changes, fixes, or updates to the current version, so yes patches will continue[/b]. But there is one point we need to state for sure, and that is some bugs could not be fixed in the meantime [i](of course, if it's a game-breaking bug we will take immediate action to fix it)[/i] therefore we decided that it would be better to do some of this fixes through the code base changed version.
 
While our programming team works on this overhaul and fixes, our 3D, animation, level design, sfx, and vfx reworks are also will keep coming.
 
[h2]What to expect with this?[/h2] 
Gunplay and movement changes, guns and attachment stats will impact your gameplay. The general responsiveness of the game will be different and better. Higher performance and optimization.
 
Also, with that new base code, we will have a chance to increase AI density and spawning systems on the maps. [b]This also brings another freedom for the level design, we want to make them wider and break that linear feeling much more[/b] (This will take time, can't do an overnight tbh).
 
[h2]Cleaning what's left from UE4[/h2]
You may know [b]we started with UE4 and then moved to UE5[/b]. We kept the UE4 skeleton system until now, but with the overhaul, we are going to get rid of UE4 skeleton systems and renew with UE5, this will give our animators more freedom, and with that, it will impact some of the character animations look better.

[h2]Directx 11/12 Controversy [/h2] 
We are using LOD (for DX11) & Nanite (DX12). To do this we did every single 3D mesh with LOD and Nanite, which made our 3D teams work double. Because this double-edged work has brought many issues, we are wasting our time fixing them to make work fine on both sides. For a small dev team, this is not efficient. Also for the lighting, we did not use Lumen because Lumen works better with Nanite and/or Virtual Shadow Maps, so when we tested Lumen with DX11 results were very very bad, and decided not to do it.
 
But [b]as we have seen on the reports many of the players are using DX12[/b]. So this brought us a new thought that we have started to consider removing the DX11 option, going for DX12, using Nanite, VS, and relighting all the levels with Lumen for more quality. But this is [b]still a consideration[/b], we have not yet reached a final decision. [b]We just wanted you all to know this thought[/b].

[h2]New and more detailed roadmap[/h2] 
We will continue to move forward with a Roadmap but we made a board for you to see more details.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43165648/226b650b2b9822e3ec9f25a05b24b6f188355258.png[/img]
Its here: [url=https://trello.com/b/ONhZeb8g/contain-roadmap-details]DETAILED ROADMAP[/url]
 
We believe even after that overhaul, Contain could feel like a new game. Thank you all for your support and feedback for making Contain a better game.

For more information and details or if you want to get in touch and speak with us please consider joining our[url=https://discord.gg/JQWh6C4DJA] Discord[/url]. We are online, and we mostly use Discord for instant, direct communications.
 
[i]- Contain DEV Team[/i]

notes.title: Changelog | New Big Patch is Live!
notes.content:
Hey, everyone!

As a small development team, like those big patches started to take time to release. With this patch, we have introduced many fixes, changes, and new features with a new CQB mission - Echo Surge.

[h1]Fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Fixed the issue if a player enters and exits the pause menu after death, they can move the character.
[*] Fixed the bug where players that are in a down but not dead state can still shoot.
[*] Fixed mouse cursor disappearing when entering and exiting the pause menu while dead.
[*] Fixed VoIP not working at mission levels.
[*] Improved VoIP sound quality.
[*] Fixed the empty mag bugs that occur randomly upon reloading.
[*] Fixed hold lean setting.
[*] Fixed hold aim setting.
[*] Fixed VSYNC setting.
[*] Fixed stretching issues of loading screens in wider screens.
[*] Fixed some settings not being saved correctly.
[*] Fixed the Joining a session via Steam friends list issue.
[*] Fixed the bug where if the Specimen (Weeping Angel) in Loose Ends mission kills a player, the post-death UI does not appear.
[*] Fixed some client-side network problems regarding mission object interactions.
[*] Fixed some belt & vest attachment bugs.
[*] Fixed a bug where the fire modes break if a player changes weapon while in burst fire mode to a weapon that doesn't have burst fire mode.
[*] Fixed a bug caused by network issues that cause endless loading time while connecting to a game in the main menu.
[*] Fixed session list not auto-refreshing on start.
[/list]

[h1]Changes (UI/UX & Gameplay)[/h1]
[list]
[*] Players now are immune to all damage received within 4 seconds of being revived. [u][b][i](Community Request)[/i][/b][/u]
[*] You can now switch to both of your primary and secondary weapons and inspect them at the Base of Operations main floor [u][b][i](Community Request)[/i][/b][/u]
[*] We are changing the datapad/scan mechanic as mentioned before. It's now working with a one-button stroke and shows where the objectives are with markers. The scan still shows anomalies/objectives behind the walls with a red overlay. [u][b][i](Community Request)[/i][/b][/u]
[*] We've also added the mission name and difficulty details on the screen for joining players. This way, they can know which mission and difficulty has been chosen by the Host player. [u][b][i](Community Request)[/i][/b][/u]
[*] Added an FOV slider to the Control Settings menu. [u][b][i](Community Request)[/i][/b][/u]
[*] Increased max primary magazine amount limit to 8. [u][b][i](Community Request)[/i][/b][/u]
[*] Reworked character health/damage/death system entirely: Now players always get in the down but not dead state after sustaining enough damage to drain their health. If they can't revive themselves or get revived by a teammate in time, they will die. Additionally, if a player chooses to die instantly while in the down but not dead state, they can hit the interact button to let go.
[*] Removed some unused controls in the settings.
[*] You can no longer heal yourself while on max health.
[*] The Datapad screen no longer stays off when not in use. Now, you can track the percentage of Recalibration live. We are making changes to suit the new UI and task-tracking system.
[*] We've removed the placeholder for Player Card Info and made it cooler and more detailed. Now, you can see your teammates' health & resources, such as the number of grenades they have, etc.
[*] Mission loading screens have been reworked.
[*] When a player joins or leaves the Base of Operations, the other players will be informed on the HUD.
[*] Option added to unequip NVGs without changing headgear.
[*] You now can see the equipment info while attaching equipments to your vest or belt.
[*] Restart Mission button added to the post-death widget, visible for the host player.
[*] Equippable max stimpack amount limited to 7. 
[*] Restocking now refills stim packs as well as grenades.
[*] More QoL changes at Gun Customization UI
[*] Flashlight & Laser activation and deactivation sounds changed.
[/list]

[h3]Missions[/h3]
[list]
[*] We made some layout and lighting changes.
[*] We have added Ammo Refill locations.
[/list] 

[h1]New Features[/h1]
[list]
[*] Now you can always track the next objective location(s) on your compass, with no need an active scanning. [u][b][i](Community Request)[/i][/b][/u]
[*] Gameplay UI can be Hide/Show with one TAB button stroke. [u][b][i](Community Request)[/i][/b][/u]
[*] We have added a small screen shake if the player gets shot. [u][b][i](Community Request)[/i][/b][/u]
[*] Jump - yep, now you can jump over or onto small obstacles. [u][b][i](Community Request)[/i][/b][/u]
[*] Mag Counts. While reloading, restocking, or during a magazine check, you can now see how many magazines you have and the amount of ammo in each. The current magazine is always displayed on the right side (Next to your gun), separated by a small yellow line. [u][b][i](Community Request)[/i][/b][/u]
[*] Some sidearms now have built-in flashlights.
[*] HUD now includes a health bar, info about remaining grenades & stimpacks and hotkeys to use previously unshown equipment. [u][b][i](Community Request)[/i][/b][/u]
[*] Missions are now shown in the HUD.
[*] Door mechanics added into Echo Surge Mission.
[*] A new mini-game mechanic added into Echo Surge Mission a PC Terminal / Console.
[/list]

[h1]AI[/h1]
[list]
[*] We're introducing two new Anomaly Soldier types equipped with SMGs and Shotguns.
[quote]Their behavior will differ from those carrying ARs. As expected, soldiers armed with SMGs and Shotguns will prefer more closer range for combat. Particularly, AI utilizing Shotguns will attempt to close the distance to players. While doing so, they will sprint until reaching a certain minimum distance.
[/quote]
[*] Soldier AIs won't walk and pass next to you with/without shooting anymore. And if they are out of their shooting range they will start sprinting to get closer to you or your teammate.
[quote]That will depend on the EQS's threat calculation at that moment.[/quote]
[*] We reduced Anomaly Soldier AI's sight angle from 90 to 65, this change made them more humane(ish) they won't see to over 65 degrees on the sides if they are not aware. 
[quote]This may change again with the feedback we will get[/quote]
[*] We increased Anomaly Soldier AI's sight and hear radius.
[*] Crawler (Named as Queen by our community) now can die before her animation ends. [quote]Queen's animation and behavior may change on the next patches.[/quote]
[*] We decreased the aggressiveness of other anomaly enemies.
[quote]Also, this one may change again with the feedback we will get[/quote]
[*] New Enemy-type Husk (Melee Horde Spawns) added into Echo Surge Mission. [b][i][u](Experimental)[/u][/i][/b]
[/list]

Please continue giving us your feedback. And consider sending your bug or if you want to get in touch and speak with us please consider joining our[url=https://discord.gg/JQWh6C4DJA] Discord [/url]. We are online, and we mostly use Discord for instant, direct communications.

notes.title: First & Longest Dev Blog after the EA Launch!
notes.content:
In this first Dev Blog, we summed up all the fixes and changes we made after the EA Launch of Contain. And what we are up to for the near feature patches.

As you may know, our early access journey started over a month ago. However, the initial reception wasn't quite what we had hoped for. Negative reviews and critical feedback flooded in on launch day, prompting us to take a step back and reevaluate our approach.

Then we started to work again in a heartbeat and released our first minor patch after few hours later and we kept doing it as fast as we could. A few days later we fixed one of the biggest issues in the game, [b]The AI Soldiers were trying to wall bang through thick walls[/b].
[i](Yes, it should have been fixed before the launch, this was just one of the biggest mistakes we made).[/i]

[h3]Gameplay Changes & Added Features:[/h3]
[list]
[*]Compass / Scan system has changed [b](Community request)[/b]
[i]While you can see your objective locations with yellow POI icons, now also you can see the objectives behind the walls, etc. without using scanning (without scanning can be changed). Environmental anomalies are still can be seen if the scan used, but can't be seen behind the walls.[/i]
[*]For the Safe Hold mission we added a countdown timer on top of the screen [i](Later, we will relocate this timer to the datapad)[/i]. [b](Community request)[/b]
[i]This made it easy to track when the Cube would complete and the mission failed.[/i]
[*]Self revive. [b](Community request)[/b]
[*]Solo Play without Creating a Lobby. [b](Community request)[/b]
[*]Mission Difficulty options. [b](Community request)[/b]
[*]Color coding for anomalies as white for containable and red for aggressive enemies.
[*]We made NVG as default equipment. [b](Community request)[/b]
[*]We have added at least one reflex sight for every rifle and SMG as default. [b](Community request)[/b]
[*]Weapon inspect default key binding is moved to "I" instead of "G" and Frag Grenade throw default key binding is "G" [b](Community request)[/b]
[*]Mouse sensitivity and inverted mouse option added.
[*]Toggle options for aiming and leans have been added.
[*] The opening cinematic was removed from the start. [i](it's on our [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=d4jQ4XQ48Is]youtube [/url]channel)[/i] [b](Community request)[/b]
[*]Some of the environmental VFXs are removed [b](Community request)[/b].
[*]Mission [b]map layouts have changed[/b], with the revamp to our current mission-level layouts now you may choose more ways to go. And sync/split executions/approaches with your teammates.
[/list]

[h3]AI[/h3]
[list]
[*]Anomaly Soldier doesn't have snap headshot aims anymore.
[*]Anomaly Soldier won't try to start shooting from behind the walls.
[*]Anomaly Soldier reaction time is slightly decreased. [b](Depending on the difficulty)[/b]
[*]Anomaly Soldiers have different recoils [b](Depending on the difficulty)[/b]
[*]Anomaly Soldier sight and hearing ranges adjusted. [b](Depending on the difficulty)[/b]
[*]Anomaly Soldier's shooting through behind the bushes issue has been fixed.
[*]Anomaly Soldier Hit Points adjusted. [b](Depending on the difficulty)[/b]
[*]Increased the distance of AI's hearing to player sounds, and allowed them to react more accurately to player footsteps and gunshots. [b](Depending on the difficulty)[/b]
[*]Anomaly AI hitbox sizes have been slightly increased and Hit Points adjusted.
[/list]

[h3]Fixes & other Features:[/h3]
[list]
[*]Green Screen Glitch on AMD GPUs with DX12 fixed.
[*]Collision fixes on the maps.
[*]Motion Blur toggle added.
[*]FOV adjustment added.
[*]DLSS added.
[*]The key binding save issue has been solved and is more detailed now.
[*]The saving issue with the options is solved.
[*]The random full black atmosphere issue on the Too Late mission was fixed.
[*]Loading Screen issues fixed.
[*]Mag check icons visibility issue fixed.
[*]VSYNC has been improved.
[*]Graphic settings have been improved.
[/list]
For a clear understanding of the basic controls of the game, we have added default key binding information to the Base of Operations Loading Screen. Also, we have added the same information to office screens as an environment dressing in the Base of Operations, they can be seen around.

[h2]What's coming Next?[/h2]

[b]A Beta branch for those who want to test a patch or feature before it goes live![/b]

Firstly, our patches are getting bigger, and more complex. Also, as can be seen below content is already has started to change, and some gameplay mechanics are changing too as the community requests, so we will open a beta branch or a version of the game that can be downloaded separately for a patch to test before it goes live. So we can be sure it's working as intended, and as the community likes it or not.

[i]This one was another mistake that we made, perhaps launching with a playtest version first would have been better to align us with our community. And we don't want to continue making this mistake, so here we are. [b]Whoever owns the game can just try with a click, no fishy catch. We will announce it when it's ready.[/b][/i]

[h3]What we are cooking right now and a rough list of what you get with the next upcoming patches?[/h3]
[list]

[*]VOIP
[*]Matchmaking
[*]The end game screen has changed. Removed unnecessary information until their respective mechanics were added.
[*]In The Base of Operations we added another Gunsmith interaction zone (a table) for gun customizations in the Locker Room.
[i](We have seen many players missing the Big Gunsmith next to the mission select computer, and they go firing range to make changes on their guns *sob*)[/i]
[*]Made some changes to AI behaviors. For example, when a player is in a bush Soldiers won't see them, and if not close enough to a player they can pass and go without a notice. [i](Not every single bush of course and not final, we will continue to work on this to make it more variable.)[/i]
[*]We started on rework for the Audio and made changes for better attenuations and occlusions.[i] (Again, not final, we will continue to work on this to make it better)[/i]
[*]We made some collision changes to the environment models so bullets won't blocked right next to a wall or a model. [i](Still can be here and there, please report)[/i]
[*]We made VFX changes on the grenade, the explosion looks cooler.
[*]Anomaly enemy VFXs are reworked too. Removed the glitch effect on the Distrupter enemy.
[*]Increased Distrupter's core size for easy to shoot, and also changed its color from White to Red.
[i](Generally, if some red things are coming to you, kill'em all! :) )[/i]
[*]New environment and enemy sounds have been added. And some changed.
[*]Door Mechanics. [i](Peeking, unlocking, or breaching with a Kick/C2/Crowbar/Battering Ram)[/i]
[*]Ballistic Shields [i](Yep, it's already on the wall of Gunsmith)[/i]
[*]FSR.
[*]New behavior for soldiers. They can crouch while shooting.
[i](not everytime and the position where they are)[/i]
[/list]
[h3]New Enemies [/h3]
(Images below are still on WIP, not final)

[b]The Husks.[/b] If they see or hear a player, they run and hit melee, easy to kill but disturbs and annoys the players.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43165648/a4224214892228017fdce675f428529e599e23f0.png[/img]

[b]The Spider Lady[/b] [i](We need a name for her, open for suggestions)[/i]

We are not giving any details about her behaviors and where and when she will appear. But all we can say about her is that as we told in our story cinematic, many people (corps, mercs, cults, etc.) started hunting the anomalies for their interest, and some of them wanted them [b]for their new tech research[/b] and others wanted them [b]for human experiments[/b] while Contain teams trying to capture and/or destroy those anomalies. [b]This is just one example of "that" human experiments.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43165648/8ff19f0c2a3e629d6b8da9c7639b30d4fe872164.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43165648/06c2d71758b6abc7de07ef9ee468477887be6811.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43165648/15f31d225abdb45b6723235f8a758af7e74327ad.png[/img]

[h3]New UI Design[/h3]
(Images below are still on WIP, not final)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43165648/5b8692c0fe3b9c64bedae400b01d8ec5343faa10.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43165648/35ead322760f63eb1ef8b7044cb7e4e2423ca4d2.png[/img]

With the new main menu UI changes, we will introduce in-game UI changes too. When they are ready, we will share and show images for it. We believe all those changes will improve the UX. Soon, we say no more for confusing and clunky UI!

[h3]Most Asked, wanted, requested, you name it![/h3]

We also started to work on a specific change and new features for the game that we have to list separately, Those are heavily requested/talked about by the community. Yes, we have started working on them!

[list]
[*]Total overhaul for the gunplay and character movements.
[*] Extraction-type missions.
[*]Progression System.
[/list]

[b]THE Progression System[/b]

Oh boy! We planned this while we started developing Contain, but then decided not to do it, and removed it because we thought that [i]"Not many players want this. And letting everything be accessible will make it better."[/i] But as all we can see, nope, we just killed the feeling of progression in the game. [b]MISTAKE![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43165648/39853203e329b4e59614c7f88afadf40a3c31265.gif[/img]

So, while we are coming to the end of this Dev Blog, We would like to remind you that those three will take time to balance, change, add, or remove things. So we decided to start small and we will continue to expand the features with the feedback we get.

As can be seen, our journey is far from over. With each passing day, we are in pursuit of a better game. Your feedback remains our compass and guides us toward the Contain's full potential. In the feature, we stand transparent and responsive. Your voices matter, we have listened and we keep doing it. With your support, we're confident that the best is yet to come.

For more information and details or if you want to get in touch and speak with us please consider joining our [b][url=https://discord.gg/JQWh6C4DJA]Discord[/url][/b]. We are online, and we mostly use Discord for instant, direct communications.

Thank you for embarking on this journey with us and thank you for your feedback.

[i]- Contain Development Team[/i]

notes.title: Content Update Details!
notes.content:
Another patch has gone live, addressing various issues. In this update, we aimed to deliver a content update focusing on some of the most requested features. These represent the fastest updates we can bring as starters, with more to follow.

[h3]Solo Play without Creating a Lobby[/h3]
For players who prefer [b]Solo[/b], you can now play without creating a lobby.

[h3]Mission Difficulty Option[/h3]
As you may know, our [b]AI is no longer trying to shoot behind the walls, and no more snap headshots[/b]. Their sight and hearing behaviors have been improved. ([i]We keep working on them to make it better[/i])

Despite fixing numerous issues with the AI, some players still found the difficulty too hard, while others thought it was too easy. We attempted to balance it, but finding a sweet spot for both sides proved tricky. While working on this, players requested different Mission Difficulty options, and we decided to add three options: [b]Regular[/b], [b]Hardcore[/b], and [b]Contain[/b] for the hardest. We will continue to balance these difficulty settings based on the feedback we receive.

[h3]Self Revive[/h3]
In solo runs and co-op, many players requested the [b]Self Revive on DBND[/b]. With this patch, now you can revive yourselves and take another opportunity to stay in the fight.

[h3]Color Coding for Anomalies[/h3]
We decided to use [b]color differences to make the gameplay more visually understandable[/b]. It was challenging to distinguish between passive and containable anomalies and aggressive ones, especially on the Too Late mission. Therefore, we changed the colors for them - [b]White for containable and Red for active enemies[/b].

notes.title: Contain Developer Briefing #02
notes.content:
Welcome to Contain Developer Briefing #02. In this second briefing, we will once again share information about the changes and additions we've made based on the feedback received from internal tests. Since our last devlog, significant developments have taken place, as we told 3D and animators that joined our ranks. [u]For those eager to contribute, we're currently hiring AI, UX, and gameplay developers[/u]. 

Also, we are thrilled to announce that the Early Access release is scheduled for [b]16.01.2024[/b]!

Prior to the official Early Access release date, we plan to conduct a [b]Playtest on Steam[/b]. However, the specific date for the playtest is yet to be determined. Rest assured, the playtest will take place before the official Early Access release, allowing us to gather valuable feedback and try to make any necessary adjustments. We appreciate your excitement and patience as we work towards delivering the best possible experience for our community.

Let's start by taking a look at our latest video, which can be found here: 
[previewyoutube=juM5UUVmnI4;full][/previewyoutube]

Our 3D and animation team is diligently working on creating our own assets, beginning with hero assets.

[previewyoutube=cYSvSQQRw8Y;full][/previewyoutube]
[previewyoutube=WVRmjGGfC-w;full][/previewyoutube]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43165648/6d628ce17b9ca1d15e2c25b58613d752f8f8cb1a.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43165648/c740562bb352f7682f997c7b6f16a17a509586d3.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43165648/2c3140e6fd07aab87a27e51e1a6f50440a030f99.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43165648/58af4c11ad0a874d27175660ba9594c601994978.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43165648/29be074948654ae025ae1878616a77ed00f8ebab.png[/img]

[u][h2]The DataPad[/h2][/u]

As mentioned in our Discord server conversations ([url=https://discord.gg/ANpKXYWEc8]if you haven't joined yet, we encourage you to do so[/url]), the DataPad is not merely a cosmetic item; it serves a purpose.

The DataPad Tool is your ultimate companion in the world of Contain. It is your trusty sidekick and secret weapon for unraveling mysteries hidden in plain sight. Whether you're scanning anomalies, detecting distant enigmas, or confirming your objectives, this versatile gadget is your key to achieving your goals. Some anomalies remain invisible to the naked eye, leaving you no choice but to scan and unveil the secrets that lie just beyond the surface.

You can check out the tool test in this video: [previewyoutube=5tbMD0HPjUE;full][/previewyoutube]

[u][h2]AI Behaviors[/h2][/u]

We have begun recreating AI behaviors to make them more active and capable of making logical decisions. In these two videos, the first shows the AI's responses to player-thrown frag grenades, and the second demonstrates how the AI reacts to player-thrown flashbangs while they remain unaware.

1. [previewyoutube=sVY1AUcO_-0;full][/previewyoutube]
2. [previewyoutube=bcJkXgfduTQ;full][/previewyoutube]
3. [previewyoutube=-n0EY0TBK8o;full][/previewyoutube]
[i]We will share more videos about AI behaviors as they further develop.[/i]

[h2][u][b]Mini F.A.Q.[/b][/u][/h2]

[i]As we continue to share more footage, additional questions have surfaced. We'd like to address some of the most frequently asked ones.[/i]

[b]Q: Is it safe to say the game is a full horror FPS?[/b] 
[b]A:[/b] [i]No, we can't say that. However, there are some jumpscare sequences here and there.[/i]

[b]Q: We see some sequences, like the police car in the latest video; are those always the same or random?[/b]
[b]A:[/b] [i]Those are 100% the same sequence at the designated location, but we are trying to make them appear (work) randomly.[/i]

[b]Q: What mission types will we see?[/b]
[b]A:[/b] [i]For now, we have a few different locations/missions, and every mission has its own theme and specific scenario. But, later on, we are planning to add different scenario types for every mission, like other games did.[/i]

[b]Q: Is there a progression system planned?[/b]
[b]A:[/b] [i]Currently, we don't have one, but we are considering the possibility. Perhaps in the mid/late Early Access Phase, we could implement one, depending on player preferences.[/i]

[b]Q: Is there a PvP or PvPvPvE mode?[/b]
[b]A:[/b] [i]The answer is a bit tricky, similar to the Progression System. We did not plan it at the beginning; we just wanted to create a full co-op or solo gameplay. But, we started considering it because many players are asking for it—some for classic PvP, others for Extraction PvPvPvE. We will probably add a mode during the Early Access Phase, depending on what our community really wants to see.[/i]

[b]Q: What type of enemies will we see?[/b]
[b]A:[/b] [i]In the initial missions, expect mostly Soldiers due to lore considerations. However, anomaly enemies will still make appearances. As the game expands with new areas and missions, the variety of anomaly enemy types will also grow. We're excited to introduce our unique anomaly enemy types and incorporate well-known SCP monsters because we know you're eager to face them.[/i]

That’s it for this time, thanks for reading! See you all next time!

Don't forget to join our [url=https://discord.gg/ANpKXYWEc8]Discord[/url]!

notes.title: Contain Developer Briefing #01
notes.content:
Welcome to the [b]Contain[/b] developer briefing. First, we would like to say this game is one of the passion projects we want to achieve, it will take time to get to the point of what we want to achieve, and we would like to thank you all for bearing with us!

Yes, after staying quiet for too long, this will be the first briefing we are sharing with you. But it will not be the last. ([i][b]*shouts in the office*[/b][/i] [i]'Hey, guys! Will it be?'[/i])

In this very first briefing, we will share information about that what we have changed, what we added, and what we gave up with the feedback that we received after the first teaser, internal tests. 

[h2][b]Let's talk about the eye-catching changes first![/b][/h2]

The level lights are changed! One of the points we received the most criticism after our teaser video was that the whole place was unnecessarily too dark and poorly lit. So we did all the existing lighting and prepared it from scratch.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43165648/19b70909c98d156d5bae866b627e2104763495c2.png[/img]

[previewyoutube=Lut2K0Ep4ic;full]https://youtu.be/Lut2K0Ep4ic[/previewyoutube]

Of course, we didn't just fix the lighting. Thanks to our new 3D artists who joined our team, we started to reduce the UE Marketplace-weighted models and replace them with our own models. But a reminder, this process will take time, and we will continue to change the assets bit by bit.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43165648/f644483b323bcab712f6afb2584ebb1a462aab71.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43165648/43cd78be1a105a4619a841786e746b6f27580a63.png[/img]
[i]what could this be?[/i]

[h2][b]FPS animations![/b][/h2]

The most crucial point of an FPS game is the gun feel. Again, it was a topic that attracted the attention of many players in our teaser video, thanks to our animation artist friends who joined our team, Contain will have better FPS animations. And we will continue to update and polish it to get even better.

[previewyoutube=GBrBznDP-Vw;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2][b]Let's look at the first batch of usable weapons![/b][/h2]

Probably, at the beginning of Early Access not all of these will be available to use, but eventually, they will. And then, more will be added. [b](Feel free to request!)[/b]

[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43165648/1ac9fd1559cb6245b97d49d74ab1bc38a436f6aa.png[/img]
Selection of gun choices is not the only thing, we want to give you dozens of options to customize your guns. Selection of handgrips, lasers, red dot sights even barrels, you name it! And yes, in time we want to expand it as much as we can.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43165648/73fada1cd16767865c42654bfced77a71c22d223.png[/img]

[i][u]Possibly Secondary Guns will not be customizable during the first weeks of Early Access.[/u][/i]

[h2][b]Paranormal events and scenario flow![/b][/h2]

As you know, Contain is not a conventional military simulation or arcade FPS. Although Contain will not have sequential chapters and a linear narrative on the scenario side, the story will continue to progress with new missions (It is not clear at the moment how often we will release new missions/maps) and you will start facing different enemies and environments with their respective mass anomaly that you have to Contain, stop, or destroy.

Some of the paranormal (or non-paranormal) events you will encounter during the missions will continue to work randomly, sometimes you will experience different mini-events (Sequences). However, in the feedback we received, we also encountered players who wanted these mini-events to be turned off completely. Of course, instead of doing this, we again attributed it to a random possibility, so that the next (or first) time you play that mission, no paranormal events may occur. This possibility can be tuned with your feedback, we can increase or decrease it. However, keep that in mind, some mission areas may not have active events, at all due to the nature of the mission.
[b]
[i]When it's good enough and after our final decision has been made we will share more visual information about events, anomalies, and the enemies you will face.[/i][/b]

[h2][b]Ahh, yes, THE optimization![/b][/h2]

While we were working with UE5, we thought why not use Nanite? We're setting it up, but the game needs to run on DX12 to be able to use Nanite, and we know there are gamers out there who want to run the game on DX11. For that, we are optimizing the Level of Details (LODs), shaders, cull details, textures, etc. As the game gets more optimized at every step, you can achieve minimum playable FPS on lower graphics cards[b]. (We'll provide more information on the minimum system requirements before the Early Access version)[/b].

[h2][b]Where is the Demo?[/b][/h2]

Well, as we talked about in our Discord Server the publishing and playtesting part can't give much information about it. But yes, we are still planning to do a small playtest with some of the randomly selected players, and some well-known YouTubers (if they want to try ofc) but no worries after that test, Early Access will be released ASAP. [i]You know, at least that's what we plan. :)[/i]

We are approaching the end of the preparations for the first gameplay video, we will make you wait a little longer. Sorry. :/
